cell_type_or_model: contusive SCI; spinal-cord microglia and astrocytes; LPS-stimulated primary cultures
assay_or_perturbation: anti-IL-6 antibody; JAK2 inhibitor AG490; minocycline intervention
evidence_summary: IL-6 neutralization attenuated JAK2/STAT3 signaling and astrocyte/microglial activation after SCI; AG490 produced similar pathway and pain-behavior effects.
limitations: The study supports an IL-6/JAK2/STAT3 pathway and SCI function, but does not by itself resolve IL-6R/gp130 molecular occupancy or a direct STAT3 target gene.

cell_type_or_model: acute contusive SCI; neural stem/progenitor cells and spinal lesion tissue
assay_or_perturbation: anti-mouse IL-6R antibody MR16-1; histology and functional recovery assays
evidence_summary: IL-6R blockade suppressed astrocytic differentiation in vitro, astrogliosis and inflammatory invasion after SCI, and improved functional recovery.
limitations: The report does not isolate STAT3 from the broader JAK/STAT pathway or provide a terminal STAT3 target-gene edge.

cell_type_or_model: primary calvarial osteoblasts and osteoclastogenesis co-culture context
assay_or_perturbation: OSM treatment; siRNA silencing of OSMR, IL6ST/gp130, STAT3 and SHC1; qPCR, scRNA-seq and in situ hybridization
evidence_summary: OSM induced Wnt16; the response depended on gp130, OSMR, SHC1 and STAT3 and was independent of ERK.
limitations: The model is bone rather than SCI; this is strong pathway/target evidence but not SCI receiver-cell applicability.

cell_type_or_model: developing spinal cord; primary cortical progenitors; astrocyte progenitors
assay_or_perturbation: CNTF stimulation; STAT1 knockout; STAT3 conditional knockout; STAT3 overexpression and promoter/reporters
evidence_summary: STAT3, but not STAT1, was required for CNTF-associated astrocyte differentiation; CNTF induced STAT3 phosphorylation and astrocyte-marker transactivation in progenitor models.
limitations: This is developmental/progenitor evidence rather than injured adult astrocytes and does not establish a single direct STAT3 target gene.

species: human Hep3B and mouse Hepa-1 comparator systems
cell_type_or_model: receptor-negative Hep3B receptor reconstitution; endogenous Hepa-1 signaling
assay_or_perturbation: LIF, OSM and IL-6 stimulation; receptor-subunit reconstitution; STAT DNA-binding and IL-6-responsive transcription assays
evidence_summary: LIFR-gp130 and OSMR-gp130 complexes activated STAT1, STAT3 and STAT5B and induced IL-6-responsive transcription; receptor cytoplasmic composition affected signaling specificity.
limitations: Comparator systems; does not establish SCI receiver-cell relevance or a ligand-specific terminal target gene.
